$schema_note: MTower Studio — props catalog (weapons, equipment, everyday objects). Prompts describe the object only.

props.name: AKM assault rifle
props.prompt: AKM assault rifle with wooden stock and handguard and a curved magazine
props.verify: Fixed vs. folding stock for 1973 Sa'iqa units

props.name: RPG-7 launcher
props.prompt: Soviet RPG-7 launcher with PGO-7 optical sight and a PG-7V rocket loaded, canvas rocket carrier bag
props.training_note: Launcher: dark steel tube with reddish-brown wooden heat guard and pistol grip, a flared black exhaust cone at the rear, about 95 cm long. Rocket: olive-green tail tube with a black pointed warhead; when loaded, only the warhead sticks out of the front of the launcher.

training_actions.edit: Show a soldier in a plain 1970s khaki uniform aiming the {NAME} on his right shoulder, seen from the side, his face hidden behind the optical sight
training_actions.caption: aimed on a soldier's shoulder, side view

training_actions.edit: Show the {NAME} held upright between the knees of a seated soldier in khaki trousers: the full-size launcher (about 95 cm long) stands with its flared exhaust cone on the floor and reaches up to his chest, loaded so only the black warhead sticks out of the top; no separate rocket; only his hands and knees visible
training_actions.caption: held upright between a seated soldier's knees

training_actions.edit: Show a soldier in a 1970s khaki uniform seen from behind, holding the {NAME} above his head with both arms while wading through shallow water that reaches only his knees, his thighs and hips dry above the water
training_actions.caption: held overhead by a soldier wading knee-deep, seen from behind

training_actions.edit: Show only the launcher, loaded: the rocket pushed fully into the FRONT end of the launcher so only the black pointed warhead sticks out of the front, the flared exhaust cone at the rear; no separate rocket, no people, side view on a plain grey background
training_actions.caption: loaded, only the warhead sticking out of the front, side view

props.name: 9M14 Malyutka (AT-3 Sagger) anti-tank missile
props.prompt: Soviet 9M14 Malyutka (AT-3 Sagger) wire-guided anti-tank missile on its fibreglass suitcase launcher, with the separate control box and periscope sight
props.scale_note: Missile about 0.86 m long and 12.5 cm across, on a launch rail on the lid of a knee-high fibreglass suitcase; reaches about knee height on a standing man.
props.training_note: The missile, its fins, and the suitcase launcher are all painted matt olive-drab green (not silver or grey).

training_actions.edit: Show a soldier in a plain 1970s khaki uniform lying prone a few metres behind the {NAME}, looking into the periscope sight of a small separate control box, his face hidden by the sight
training_actions.caption: with an operator lying prone at the control box behind it

props.name: RKG-3 anti-tank hand grenade
props.prompt: Soviet RKG-3 stick-handled anti-tank hand grenade
props.verify: Model used by Egyptian commandos in 1973
props.training_note: Painted olive-drab green: a fat ribbed cylindrical head on a long thin tubular handle, about 36 cm long in total — the length of a forearm. Always shown lying on its side or held in a hand, never standing on end.

training_actions.edit: Show a soldier's hand in a khaki sleeve gripping the {NAME} by its handle, close-up
training_actions.caption: gripped by its handle in a soldier's hand

training_actions.edit: Show a soldier in a 1970s khaki uniform seen from behind, arm raised, about to throw the {NAME}
training_actions.caption: about to be thrown by a soldier, seen from behind

props.name: Handwritten Arabic letter
props.prompt: a page of lined paper with an everyday family letter in Arabic handwriting in pencil (greetings to his mother and his little sister, news from the camp, asking after the neighbours), written in soft, loose, slightly smudged pencil strokes that read as handwriting texture rather than as sharp legible words, folded
props.note: Arabic handwriting must look like real Arabic script — review closely. No legible religious phrases (Basmala, verses): keep the words soft and unreadable (global no-Quran rule, 2026-10-14).
